criteria.text: Snapshot engine permissions/questions during bridge connect/reconnect (opencode_stream_bridge.ts) — the engine's /permission and /question surfaces are the authority.
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c1: bridge connect snapshots both authoritative engine interaction surfaces

criteria.text: Add an SDK-session→local-session repository fallback where the in-memory opencodeSessionMap misses (cold maps after restart).
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c2: cold maps recover both interaction kinds through sdk_session_id

criteria.text: Include pending interactions in desktop connect/attach snapshots (ws_gateway.ts attach path).
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c3: late desktop attach receives already-registered interactions

criteria.text: Normalize identity/state across both clients (one canonical pending-interaction shape with stable IDs).
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c4: permission and question use the same canonical stable-ID schema

criteria.text: Duplicate and reordered engine events do not duplicate or resurrect a terminal interaction.
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c5: duplicate and reordered events preserve one terminal interaction

criteria.text: Make resolutions idempotent/atomic under races (two clients answering simultaneously → exactly one engine reply; the loser gets the authoritative terminal state, not an error card).
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c6: simultaneous clients share one engine reply and one terminal result

criteria.text: Failed resolutions stay pending and expose a retryable error.
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c7: failed engine resolution remains pending with retryable error

criteria.text: Broadcast authoritative terminal state everywhere after server acknowledgement.
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c8: successful resolution broadcasts the canonical terminal state

criteria.text: Desktop permission cards clear ONLY after server acknowledgement; failed resolutions stay visible with retryable errors.
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c9: permission card remains until acknowledgement and retries after failure

criteria.text: Desktop question cards clear ONLY after server acknowledgement; failed resolutions stay visible with retryable errors.
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c10: question card remains until acknowledgement and retries after failure

criteria.text: Questions are answered via question.asked event + POST /question/{id}/reply (string[][]) — NOT session.input; permissions respond with the directory query parameter.
criteria.test_id: issue-3-c11: real engine continuation resolves through dedicated interaction endpoints
